1) TO BE TEMPERED UPTO 24-32 HRC.
2) RETAPPING TO BE DONE AFTER SURFACE TREATMENT AT SUPPLIER END.( IF APPLICABLE )"}],"comment":"The ⌀8 H7 hole (D24) is a tight-tolerance feature, yet the drawing does not account for the I.Z.B.P. plating thickness specified in the title block; plating buildup will reduce the bore and cause assembly interference. The designer must either specify pre-plating limits that leave room for coating or add a note masking the H7 holes during plating.","recommended_correction":"Add a note stating the H7 tolerance applies after plating with appropriate pre-plate machining allowance, or call out masking of the ⌀8 H7 holes before surface treatment."},{"rule_id":"MF-005","evidence":[{"kind":"note","ref":"N1","page":1,"quote":"HEAT TREATMENT :-
1) TO BE TEMPERED UPTO 24-32 HRC.
2) RETAPPING TO BE DONE AFTER SURFACE TREATMENT AT SUPPLIER END.( IF APPLICABLE )"}],"comment":"Note N1 specifies tempering to 24-32 HRC but does not state at which manufacturing stage the heat treatment is to be performed relative to machining and surface treatment, leaving the process sequence ambiguous. Without a defined stage the supplier may harden the part before finish machining, risking dimensional distortion of the tight-tolerance features.","recommended_correction":"Revise N1 to explicitly state when heat treatment occurs, e.g., 'Heat treat to 24-32 HRC after rough machining and before final machining and surface treatment.'"}]}
